concept: DR strategies: backup and restore — the cheapest
tests: Choosing a DR strategy at minimal cost with an acceptable RTO of several hours.
expected: Backup and restore — infrastructure is restored from backups in another region. Triggers: "lowest cost", "RTO of several hours", "restoring from backups".
why_not: Pilot light and warm standby cost more (they keep resources running); multi-site active-active — the most expensive.
